fitcode.description: Center the editor text like JetBrains does: width follows the longest line of the current file
fitcode.command.enable.title: FitCode: Enable (write into the VS Code install folder)
fitcode.command.disable.title: FitCode: Disable (restore the VS Code install folder)
fitcode.command.status.title: FitCode: Show status
fitcode.config.enabled.description: Whether FitCode is written into the VS Code install folder. Maintained by the Enable/Disable commands; do not edit by hand.
fitcode.config.center.description: Center the text. Turn it off to go back to the native layout (takes effect in 1-2 seconds, no window reload needed).
fitcode.config.paddingRight.description: Extra padding on the right of the text, in pixels.
fitcode.config.animate.description: Animate the width when switching files or when the content changes.
fitcode.config.animateDuration.descripti: Width animation duration in milliseconds. 0 disables the animation.
fitcode.config.lineNumbersOnlyAtCursor.d: Show line numbers only on the cursor lines (all of them when there are multiple cursors). Turn it off to restore the native line numbers.
fitcode.config.cacheSize.description: Maximum number of cached widths per file.
